rootIssue.title: Human parity WorkGraph proof
rootIssue.body: Exercise a human worker graded by an agent evaluator, then an agent worker normalizing the same Root Issue graded by a human evaluator.

output.proposal: Pin the reporter identity so worker tools can authenticate a routed Route.
output.rationale: Worker profiles inject no Route reporter identity on default main.

output.summary: The Root Issue asks for a human parity proof across both executor kinds.
